correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the finite commutative ring argument from the actual assigned RESULT.md and the Git tree. For u,v units, s=u+v and t=s/(uv), so either s=t=0 with N ordered representations or v_p(s)=v_p(t)=j<k. For positive j, division of s,t by p^j gives u(s-u)=a/b mod p^(k-j); the unit quadratic is square-solvable iff -a/b is square mod p, has two Hensel roots and p^j lifts per root; hence 2p^j on exactly N_j²/2 outputs. At j=0, discriminant Δ=s²-4s/t, admissible Δ ≠s² mod p; unit square residues give 2 roots, even valuation 2v has 2p^v roots, Δ=0 has p^floor(k/2); counts exhaust outputs. Squaring the five family counts and summing gives E=N²(3k-3/(p-1)); additive-character orthogonality and CRT give moments and odd composite case. Independent separately written full ordered-pair enumerator verified the exact histograms and energies for 9 local cases p=3,5,7,11 with k up to 4; this is finite corroboration only. Boundaries p=3, k=1, zero-sum, and row coincidences checked. No mathematical falsity identified.
